title.zh: Poisson 闭合 RK4 单步

summary: f_new=P4(dt*A)f; A=-ik diag(v)+(i dv/k)g 1^T. Closure at all stages.

identity.relation: f_new=P4(dt*A)f; A=-ik diag(v)+(i dv/k)g 1^T. Closure at all stages.
identity.definition: f_new=P4(dt*A)f; A=-ik diag(v)+(i dv/k)g 1^T. Closure at all stages.
identity.model: Linear one-dimensional single-spatial-Fourier-mode electrons, fixed ions.
identity.geometry: One velocity coordinate and one spatial Fourier mode.
identity.boundary: One classical RK4 step; incoming field must satisfy discrete Poisson; finite velocity window.
assumptions: Velocity-window truncation and recurrence are separate from temporal integration error.

inputs.name: dE
inputs.constraints: Finite scalar; RK4 requires Poisson consistency within rtol=1e-12,atol=1e-14.

inputs.name: vv
inputs.constraints: Finite one-dimensional; aligned with df and df0dv when applicable.

inputs.name: df0dv
inputs.description: Equilibrium derivative or declared forcing on velocity nodes.
inputs.constraints: Finite one-dimensional aligned vector; can include quadrature-deposited jump masses.

inputs.name: dt
inputs.description: Time step in inverse plasma frequency.

outputs.name: result
outputs.description: Tuple (new_df,new_dE), complex [N] vector and closed complex scalar; no input mutation.
outputs.shape: As described in output mapping or tuple.
outputs.constraints: Finite updated distribution and field preserving discrete Poisson closure.

preconditions: df, vv and df0dv are finite aligned one-dimensional vectors.
dE satisfies discrete Poisson closure; k and dv are finite with k nonzero and dv positive; dt is positive.
supported: One classical RK4 step with Poisson closure recomputed at every stage.
excluded: Nonlinear evolution, multidimensional modes and unconstrained incoming fields.

failure_semantics.invalid_input: ValueError for invalid arrays/scalars or an incoming dE outside the declared Poisson tolerance.
failure_semantics.runtime_failure: FloatingPointError when an intermediate or updated state/field is nonfinite.
failure_semantics.nonconvergence: Not applicable; exactly one prescribed step is evaluated.
failure_semantics.partial_results: No updated tuple is returned after an exception.

python.signature: vp_rk4_step(df, dE, vv, df0dv, k, dv, dt)

example.code:
from scirel.kinetic.vlasov_poisson import vp_init,vp_rk4_step
s=vp_init(nv=32)
f,E=vp_rk4_step(*(s[n] for n in ("df","dE","vv","df0dv","k","dv","dt")))
assert f.shape == (33,)
example.description: Advance one Poisson-closed RK4 step from a 32-interval initial state.
example.expected: PASS: .venv/bin/python completed; the updated distribution has shape (33,).

scope: Discrete Poisson constraint and off-diagonal rank-one feedback.
Dense matrix-exponential RK4 order; analytic free-streaming and damped-cosine diagnostics.
Slowing-down weak derivative integration-by-parts and default 2049-node/2000-step execution.
verification.evidence_ceiling: Independent semidiscrete mathematical and selected scenario regressions; actual run/installed-wheel receipts are recorded separately, not inferred from test existence.
known_limitations: Finite-window rectangle rule and sampling recurrence TR=2pi/(k*dv).
Fn4 truncated density retains original coefficient and is not renormalized after cutoff.
Peak diagnostic assumes standing oscillation; rotating complex exponential has no amplitude peaks.
